nodes.text:
You've got that look. Pockets heavy, story thin.

Don't tell me the story. Show me the pockets.

People downriver who don't ask either. A ring is a ring, friend. It doesn't remember whose finger.

Bring me the pretty useless things - the ones you can't wear, can't drink and can't swing. Those are the ones I want, and nobody else in the Landing will give you a copper for them.
